author: GamingBolt
description:
We finally get to tell you all about GTA 6's Leonida, and what a place it is for anybody who likes an open world that pulls them in and refuses to let them go. That’s definitely a part of life in this sprawling city, but it’s so much more than that. Its real beauty lies in how every distraction could turn into an opportunity to discover more of the world and get some great experiences and rewards along the way.

Leonida is a world where leaving your house to go somewhere doesn’t necessarily mean you’ll actually get there. It’s a city where the chance of something pulling you away as you round the next corner is not only ever present, but so darn welcome it’s hard to get anything done unless you’ve got Jason and Lucia's discipline to drive you. We don’t, and our time in Leonida was all the better for it.
title: GTA 6 Full Map Revealed - This Is Rockstar's BIGGEST Game Design Win Yet

author: GamingBolt
description:
With dozens of hours required to glimpse everything Leonida has to offer, Grand Theft Auto 6 can be overwhelming, especially if you're new to the series. The traditional systems of carjacking and weapon selection have changed tremendously, and committing wanton crimes with no consideration for long-term repercussions is a thing of the past. In this vast ocean of larger-than-life characters and criminals, it's all you can do sometimes to survive against the tide.

Thus, we've compiled 15 tips and tricks beginners should absolutely know to thrive and get the most out of the experience.
title: GTA 6 - 15 BEST Tips and Tricks You'll Wish You Knew Sooner
